Strings.server_center.title: Server centre
Strings.server_center.select_host_hint: Select a server and user above.
Strings.server_center.subtitle: Manage the SSH hosts used to install and maintain RelaxKonOS servers.
Strings.server_center.empty: No managed hosts have been added on this device.
Strings.server_center.cached_state: The status shown here is the last SSH verification, not a live health check.
Strings.server_center.invalid_host: Enter a valid SSH host, port, and user.
Strings.server_center.host_added: Host record saved. Add a password to use it for deployment.
Strings.server_center.host_added_with_password: Host and password were saved securely. Verify its SSH host key before deployment.
Strings.server_center.host_added_password_not_sa: Host record was saved, but the password could not be saved securely.
Strings.server_center.current_host_added: The current SSH server and user were added to managed hosts.
Strings.server_center.host_removed: The local host record was removed. No server, data, login, or SSH credential was changed.
Strings.server_center.load_failed: Unable to read local host records.
Strings.server_center.save_failed: Unable to save the local host record.
Strings.server_center.remove_failed: Unable to remove the local host record.
Strings.server_center.save_new_host_password: Save this password securely on this device
Strings.server_center.deployment_password: SSH password (leave blank to use the saved password)
Strings.server_center.host_key_review: Verify this SSH host-key fingerprint with the host administrator before trusting it:
Strings.server_center.host_key_replace_message: The fingerprint this host presented no longer matches the one saved on this device. A host rebuilt with new keys and another machine taking over this address under DHCP look exactly the same here. Accepting replaces the saved fingerprint; it is never replaced silently.
Strings.server_center.host_key_mismatch: The observed host key does not belong to the selected host.
Strings.server_center.host_key_trusted: Host key saved. Retry the deployment action.
Strings.server_center.host_key_save_failed: Unable to save the SSH host key.
Strings.server_center.password_required: No saved SSH credential exists for this server and user. Add one on the Hosts page or enter a one-time password.
Strings.server_center.platform_detecting: Detecting the host platform over SSH…
Strings.server_center.platform_detection_failed: The SSH host did not identify itself as a supported Linux or Windows host.
Strings.server_center.host_addresses_empty: No IP addresses were reported by this host.
Strings.server_center.host_addresses_failed: Unable to read IP addresses from this SSH host.
Strings.server_center.probe_help: Preflight uploads the fixed deployment launcher, reads OS, architecture, permissions and current installation status, then saves a timestamped SSH verification.
Strings.server_center.probe_succeeded: Host preflight and SSH-side status check completed.
Strings.server_center.probe_failed: Host preflight could not be completed. Check SSH access and the selected host platform.
Strings.server_center.wizard.title: Install RelaxKonOS
Strings.server_center.wizard.server_bundle: Release bundle on this SSH server
Strings.server_center.wizard.certificate_require: Choose the certificate files to continue.
Strings.server_center.wizard.bundle_required: Choose a .zip release bundle to continue.
Strings.server_center.wizard.install_blocked: Installation is blocked until the SSH host key is confirmed on the Hosts page.
Strings.server_center.unsupported_host: The selected platform does not match a supported target reported by the host preflight.
Strings.server_center.elevation_required: The selected installation mode requires an elevated SSH session or approved sudo access.
Strings.server_center.installation_identity_miss: The existing installation did not report a valid managed installation identity. Update is blocked.
Strings.server_center.release_unavailable: No release is available for this host architecture and installation mode.
Strings.server_center.local_bundle_unavailable: Choose a readable ZIP release bundle.
Strings.server_center.remote_bundle_unavailable: Choose a .zip release bundle from this SSH server.
Strings.server_center.certificate_unavailable: The selected certificate files are unavailable.
Strings.server_center.certificate_mode_unavailab: A custom TLS certificate requires a system-service installation.
Strings.server_center.install_mode_unavailable: Linux System Mode requires root or sudo; Windows System Mode requires an administrator SSH session.
Strings.server_center.wizard.sudo_password: sudo password (leave blank to use the SSH password)
Strings.server_center.sudo_failed: sudo authentication failed. Check the sudo password and account permissions.
Strings.server_center.status_missing: The deployment finished, but no authoritative SSH-side status receipt was returned.
Strings.server_center.install_succeeded: RelaxKonOS was installed and verified through SSH. Return to the login window to sign in.
Strings.server_center.update_succeeded: RelaxKonOS was updated and verified through SSH. Sign in again if the existing session was interrupted.
Strings.server_center.deploy_failed: The server operation could not be completed. Its SSH-side receipt can be checked from this host later.
Strings.server_center.uninstall_name: Type the server name to delete data
Strings.server_center.history_load_failed: Unable to read the local operation history.
Strings.server_center.status_mode_missing: The host did not report an installation mode that can be checked safely.
Strings.server_center.maintenance_preflight_fail: The host no longer reports a supported managed installation. This operation is blocked.
Strings.server_center.repair_succeeded: The current installation was repaired and verified through SSH.
Strings.server_center.rollback_succeeded: The previous program version was restored and verified through SSH.
Strings.server_center.uninstall_retained_succeed: The server was uninstalled. Managed data was retained on the host.
Strings.server_center.uninstall_deleted_succeede: The server and managed data were uninstalled.
Strings.server_center.maintenance_failed: The server operation could not be completed. Its SSH-side receipt can be checked from this host later.
Strings.server_center.operation_refreshed: The selected operation receipt was refreshed from the host.
Strings.server_center.operation_refresh_failed: The remote operation receipt could not be refreshed. Check SSH access and try again.
Strings.server_center.install_script_unavailable: The bundled installation script is unavailable. Rebuild or reinstall this client.
Strings.server_center.wizard.source_checks: Official packages are downloaded and verified on the server. Selected ZIPs receive layout, architecture and safe extraction checks.
Strings.server_center.probe_missing: The host preflight returned no system information. Check the operation record.
Strings.server_center.platform_mismatch: Selected platform: {0}; SSH host platform: {1}. Choose the host platform.
Strings.server_center.architecture_unsupported: The host CPU architecture {0} is unsupported. Supported architectures: x86_64 and arm64.
Strings.server_center.os_unsupported: The host reports {0} {1} ({2}), which is outside the supported systems. Supported Linux systems: Debian 12, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04.
